AI Overview

AI Mode replied:

Espresso
is a concentrated, bold coffee made by forcing hot water through finely ground coffee beans under high pressure (about 9 bars) for 25 to 30 seconds. It is served in small 1-ounce shots and topped with a golden foam called crema. 
How It Works
  • Grind size: Uses very fine coffee grounds, similar in texture to table salt.
  • Pressure: An espresso machine uses mechanical force (about 9 bars) to push water through a packed puck of coffee.
  • Time: The entire extraction takes only 25 to 30 seconds.
  • Crema
